info.title: SaasReport admin API
info.description: The API of admin.saasreport.ai: the contract the Worker in workers/admin implements and the admin interface (generated by the kit's workbench) reads. Contract first: `kit check contracts` keeps this file and the route literals of workers/admin/src in step, both ways. Authentication is Cloudflare Access only: no password, no user table, no cookie of its own. Every mutation is audited, same-origin, application/json and bounded.

servers.description: Production, behind Cloudflare Access (hostname pending the naming registry: component admin, sub admin).

get.summary: Who the Worker believes is calling
get.description: The verified Access identity: a hash of the email claim, never the address. Not audited (a read of nothing but the caller).

get.summary: Health of every Worker, served commits against main's head, delivery and lead counts, provisioning readiness
get.description: Each Worker is asked for GET /api/build (kit.build.v1) through its service binding or its registry hostname, bounded to a few seconds. main's head is read only when the Worker holds the optional read secret named in the config; otherwise it is reported as not available, never guessed.
Newest first. A page can hold fewer rows than `limit` while next_cursor is set: the status filter is applied to a bounded window of the leads table (docs/ADMIN.md).

patch.summary: Set a lead's status and note
patch.description: Sets the absolute state, so repeating a request changes nothing (idempotent by construction). An Idempotency-Key additionally replays the first answer without a second audit entry. Audited; same-origin and application/json only.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A caller-chosen key (1 to 64 characters). The same key with the same request replays the first answer and writes nothing; the same key with another request is a 409.

post.summary: Retry a failed delivery through the comms engine
post.description: Re-submits the stored submission under the SAME reference to the comms engine's POST /v1/comms/submit, which re-drives only the deliveries that did not go and picks the templates and the recipients itself: the admin chooses neither. Needs the stored lead of that reference. Idempotency-Key required. Audited before and after the call.

parameters.description: A caller-chosen key (1 to 64 characters). The same key with the same request replays the first answer and writes nothing; the same key with another request is a 409.

get.description: The roles of the admin and the permissions each holds, from the Worker's configuration. Every operation of this contract names the permission it needs (x-permission).

The identities on the Access allowlist (role owner, by hash) and any principal registered in the admin's database (none until an invitation is accepted, which needs the Access policy widened by the lead). Addresses are never shown.

cfAccess.name: Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion
cfAccess.description: The Cloudflare Access application token. Access adds it at the edge; the Worker verifies it again on every request: RS256 against the team's JWKS, aud, iss, exp/nbf, and an email allowlist held as a Worker secret. Missing or invalid configuration refuses every request with 503 and no detail.

comms_status.description: sent | failed | skipped, as the leads table stores it.

available.description: false when the leads table does not exist yet.

attempted.description: The deliveries that had not gone and were handed to the engine again.

destination.description: A destination label from the table (not an address the table does not hold).

sender_hash.description: A hash, as stored. The sender address is never shown.

recipient.description: The project's own mailbox that received it.

available.description: false when comms_inbound does not exist yet (the inbound handler is not deployed or not migrated).

recipient.description: An address; handed to the comms engine, never stored by the admin.

ready.description: true when every required configuration name and binding is present.

provisioning.description: The kit's provisioning registry when the repository holds provisioning.json; { available: false } otherwise.

release.description: release.json when the repository holds it; { available: false } otherwise.

matches_main.description: null when main's head is not available or the Worker is unreachable.

detail.description: Bounded; never an address or a submitted value.

state.description: available: read from a source now; empty: a source exists and holds nothing; not_connected: no source is connected, so nothing is shown.

source.description: The operation or registry the figures come from.

assignable.description: false for the owner role: it is held only through the Access allowlist.

email.description: Hashed on arrival and never stored.

E400.description: Invalid request (the validation failure names the field)

E403.description: The token is valid but the identity is not allowed, or the origin check failed

E409.description: Conflict with the stored state, or an idempotency key reused with another request

E413.description: The body is over the cap

E422.description: The request is well formed but cannot be carried out

E502.description: A service behind a binding failed

E503.description: Not configured or unavailable (no detail is given)
